metadata.description: Persian font & RTL plugins for Claude Desktop and Claude Code

plugins.name: persian-kit
plugins.description: Everything for Persian in Claude: font, right-to-left layout and correct Persian writing, in one install

plugins.name: persian-fonts
plugins.description: Choose the Persian font (Vazirmatn by default, or any installed font), applied to Arabic-script characters only

plugins.name: persian-rtl
plugins.description: Per-paragraph right-to-left direction for Persian, mixed Persian/English lines, lists, tables and the input box, with math and code kept left-to-right

plugins.name: persian-writing
plugins.description: Makes Claude write correct Persian: half-space (ZWNJ), Persian ی/ک, optional Persian digits and «» quotes
